messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: Elevated 502/5xx rate on inference-runtime (us-west1). Auto-page to oncall. Creating incident INC-2026-0456 :rotating_light:

oncall-maya: oncall here, joining bridge. any known deploys?

runtime-eli: seeing repeated segfaults in model-runner logs on node pool infer-ssd-1, stacktrace shows `SIGSEGV` inside quant_attention kernel. sample: `segfault at 0x0 ip 0x7f2a3a1c offset 0x130`

eng-pager: routing fallback kicked in, some requests are being retried to smaller model-variant (redwood-opt-8 -> redwood-opt-4). traffic shift ~20% but error rate still high for longseq requests.

support-jordan: customer telemetry: several enterprise customers reporting generation failures and 502s since ~2m ago, p95 latency + 600ms, error budget burn increasing.

runtime-lead-kai: quick containment idea: disable quantized attention kernel on affected hosts (env var `RW_DISABLE_QUANT_ATTENTION=1`) and drain/restart runners. avoids segfault if kernel bug. will that be fast?

oncall-maya: do it. infra-lin, can you push a cluster-level K8s daemonset patch or set nodepool instance metadata? need to avoid mass restarts.

infra-lin: pushing daemonset env patch now to prod-infer ns. command: `kubectl set env daemonset/model-runner RW_DISABLE_QUANT_ATTENTION=1 -n prod-infer` then `kubectl rollout restart daemonset/model-runner -n prod-infer --timeout=5m`

runtime-eli: before restart, I can add a probe-based temporary traffic cut: set route weight for pool infer-ssd-1 -> 0 in traffic router so we stop hitting faulty nodes until they restart. will update router.

eng-pager: routing update applied: infer-ssd-1 weight -> 0, traffic redirected to infer-std-2 and canary pools. observing initial drop in 5xxs.

support-jordan: customer impact: errors down ~70% after reroute; some customers still see retries failing (longseq/streamed calls). tracking customer A and B for SLA alerts.

runtime-lead-kai: performing controlled restarts on drained nodes, will tail logs and revert flag when stable. collecting core dumps to S3 (s3://prod-cores/INC-2026-0456/) for postmortem.

oncall-maya: taking ownership of incident until containment. kai, eli - stay on bridge for next 45m. eng-pager please coordinate rollback plan if errors resurface.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-0456 created. Priority: P1. PagerDuty escalation set. Runbook link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/OPS/pages/INC-2026-0456

cust-ops-zoe: notifying top-affected customers with initial high-level update. will send follow-up after containment verified.

runtime-eli: after two restarts, no new segfaults observed on restarted hosts. still monitoring KV cache growth that might correlate. collecting metrics: `model_runner.process.crashes` -> 0, `kvcache.size` stable.

infra-lin: rollout completed for daemonset across 8 nodes, 30s median restart. no core dumps post-flag.

oncall-maya: containment achieved. reducing page noise and moving to post-incident triage. leaving the bridge in 10m for handoff notes.

support-jordan: customers notified: initial P1 notice sent. will draft RCA with runtime team.

runtime-lead-kai: next steps: 1) full postmortem, 2) permanent fix for quant kernel (repro + patch), 3) add canary gating for kernel toggles, 4) add kvcache memory guardrails. assigning owners.

eng-pager: thanks everyone. saving logs and traces, marking incident status: contained -> monitoring.
